_README: The calendar. Rows are typed once by hand and then VERIFIED against the
official page every week by calendar.py. Nothing here is scraped.
THE RULE THAT SHAPES THIS FILE: a model may READ a fetched page, never
RECALL a date. Asking a model 'when does GSoC 2027 open' produces a
confident invention, and unlike a wrong job verdict a student cannot detect
it by clicking through — they just miss the deadline.
So every date-bearing field obeys this:
deadline / opens_on   set ONLY when a fetched page said so, and then
evidence.<field> holds the exact quoted sentence
and the URL it came from.
typical_open_month    a SEASON, not a date. Explicitly fuzzy: it renders
as 'usually opens in February', never as a
countdown. No countdown may ever be drawn from it.
verify_status         verified | stale | unverified | excluded
Rows below carry verified=... only where the source is stated. Dates marked
seed_verified came from jobs_memory.jsonl, which was checked by hand against
the official page on the date given. Everything else is deliberately null
until calendar.py reads the page. A null date is honest; a guessed one is
the single worst thing this file could contain.
If a page cannot be read, KEEP the last known window and mark it stale.
Never silently re-date a row.

rows.name: Outreachy
rows.window_note: Dec-2026 cohort initial applications open ~Aug/Sep 2026 (seed_verified 2026-07-18).

eligibility.prerequisite_gate: Outreachy is for people subject to systemic bias or under-representation in tech in their region. In India it is generally not open to men unless they face specific systemic bias. This is an eligibility gate the user must self-assess, not one the collector may decide.

rows.name: LFX Mentorship (CNCF and Linux Foundation projects)
rows.window_note: Term 3 runs Sep-Nov; applications open ~late Aug 2026 (seed_verified).

eligibility.prerequisite_gate: Must be eligible to work in India and NOT a prior or active LF mentee.

rows.name: MLH Fellowship — Open Source Track

eligibility.prerequisite_gate: Requires prior MLH Hackathon / Global Hack Week participation.

rows.excluded_reason: Official FAQ states it is not open to India/APAC, and it requires prior MLH Hack Week participation (seed_verified). Kept as a row so it can never be re-added by a later sweep, and so the exclusion is auditable.

rows.name: C4GT / Digital Mentorship Programme
rows.window_note: Annual summer programme; the 2026 window is closed, watch for 2027 (seed_verified).

rows.name: CERN Technical Studentship
rows.window_note: Programme was CLOSED and reopens 6 August 2026 (seed_verified on careers.cern 2026-07-18). Field list includes 'Software Engineering and IT'. Duration 4-12 months; allowance 3,486 CHF/month net plus travel to Geneva.

eligibility.degree_ceiling: PhD holders and PhD students are NOT eligible
eligibility.prerequisite_gate: Must be a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State. India is an Associate Member, so Indian nationals are eligible. Must have completed at least 18 months of study and remain enrolled full-time.
CERN Member / Associate Member State nationality; India is an Associate Member.

rows.name: Indian Academy of Sciences Summer Research Fellowship
IIT Hyderabad — Centre for Cryptography and Cybersecurity, Interns
rows.window_note: Rolling advertisement, not a fixed window (seed_verified 2026-07-31). Apply with CV, a brief research-interest statement and two references to the official CCS email; project and faculty availability vary.

eligibility.prerequisite_gate: Bachelor's in CSE, IT, EE, ECE or Mathematics.

rows.name: TCS National Qualifier Test (NQT) / TCS Prime and Digital
rows.note: One of the largest single sources of CSE fresher hiring in India and invisible to every board sweep. TCS is bot-blocked to a plain fetch, so this is deliberately a hand-typed calendar row rather than something to scrape.

eligibility.prerequisite_gate: Pre-final and final year engineering students; leads to Power Programmer / Specialist Programmer offers.
Targets B.Sc/BCA graduates rather than B.Tech; included so a non-B.Tech user is not told nothing exists.

rows.name: Cognizant GenC / GenC Next / GenC Elevate
Accenture India Fresher Hiring (ASE / Advanced ASE)

eligibility.prerequisite_gate: STEP is specifically for students in their FIRST or SECOND year of an undergraduate degree. A final-year student is not eligible — the same lower-bound gate that made Explore Microsoft a rejection.

rows.name: Google Software Application Development Apprenticeship (India)
rows.window_note: Deadline 2026-08-03; locations Bengaluru / Gurgaon / Hyderabad / Mumbai (seed_verified).

rows.name: Google Data Analytics Apprenticeship (March 2027 cohort)
rows.window_note: 24-month apprenticeship; deadline 2026-08-03 (seed_verified).

eligibility.prerequisite_gate: First and second year students ONLY. This was a real rejection in the seed data — a lower bound on study year, which most filters miss because they only check for seniority.

rows.name: Adobe India Internship / Adobe Research India
Qualcomm India Campus / Interim Engineering Intern
Goldman Sachs Summer Analyst Programme — Asia Pacific
rows.window_note: Applications open until 2026-10-04. 9-11 week internship; Mumbai is included in the official Apply Now location filter (seed_verified 2026-07-31).

eligibility.prerequisite_gate: Requires students currently in the PENULTIMATE year of a Bachelor's or Master's programme. A final-year student is a long shot, not a match — surface labelled, never as eligible.

deadline.quote: Applications are open until 2026-10-04; the program is a 9-11 week internship for undergraduate/graduate students

rows.name: Baseten Base Labs Fellowship
rows.window_note: Cohort starts late September 2026 (seed_verified).

rows.name: HENNGE Global Internship Program
rows.window_note: Software-engineering training programme in Tokyo. Round-trip airfare, medical insurance for non-residents, pre-arrival support and visa guidance are offered (seed_verified 2026-07-30).

eligibility.prerequisite_gate: Third-year undergraduate or higher in CS or a related field. English fluency required; Japanese not required.

rows.needs_confirmation: Will HENNGE arrange or sponsor the appropriate Japan entry status for an India-based candidate?

rows.name: IBM Extreme Blue
rows.window_note: IBM's flagship leadership/technical internship programme (est. 1999), run in cohorts across global labs including India. Acceptance rate is reported in the low single digits by third-party guides, not an official IBM figure (checked 2026-08-01, no fixed application window stated on the official page).

rows.name: IBM India Internship (incl. Research)
rows.window_note: General student/research internship track (research areas include hybrid cloud, security, quantum computing). Third-party cycle guides describe next-cycle applications opening late Aug/early Sep for a following-summer start (checked 2026-08-01, not an IBM-official date, treat typical_open_month as a season only).

rows.name: Samsung IGNITE Summer Internship (SRI-B)
rows.window_note: Annual summer internship run by Samsung R&D Institute Bangalore, confirmed to have run a 2026 edition (checked 2026-08-01 via Samsung Newsroom India). Distinct from Samsung PRISM, which is a college-nominated industry-academia project programme, not a directly-applied internship.

rows.name: SAP Internship Experience Program (iXp) India
rows.window_note: Global rolling internship programme with individual roles posted continuously on jobs.sap.com; no single fixed India application window found (checked 2026-08-01). Individual iXp reqs belong in the job lake via the SAP board, not here — this row exists so the programme name itself is tracked.

rows.name: DRDO Paid Internship Scheme (per-laboratory)
rows.window_note: DRDO does not run one national cycle: individual laboratories (DLRL, TBRL, DMRL, SSPL, PXE, RCI and others) each publish their own paid-internship advertisement and deadline on drdo.gov.in at different times of year, confirmed live for multiple labs in 2026 (checked 2026-08-01: DLRL advt for 2026-27 final-year B.E/B.Tech, SSPL 65 slots/₹5,000 stipend closing 30 Sep, RCI 160 vacancies for 7th/8th-sem B.Tech). This row tracks the scheme as a category; a specific lab's window is never inferred from another lab's.

eligibility.prerequisite_gate: Final-year (7th/8th semester) B.E./B.Tech, typically with a minimum CGPA around 7.0/10 — varies by laboratory.

rows.stipend_text: Varies by laboratory, commonly INR 5,000-30,000/month (seed source: multiple 2026 lab advertisements)
